senses.gloss: f.madder, a plant used in dying red.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 5:3:11">Y. Maasr. V, end, 52ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 3:1:7">Y. Pes. III, beg. 29ᵈ</cite> (ref. to <he>זומן של צבעים</he>) <he>דו יהב בגויה קוצם וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) he (the dyer) puts the madder into it to make it adhesive (v. <cite ref="G00184"><he>זוֹמָא</he> I</cite>).
